# Terrance Hah

> Personal website and projects by Terrance Hah. Pacey is a race-readiness web application.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://terrancehah.com/): About Terrance Hah.
- [Projects](https://terrancehah.com/projects): Project directory.
- [Pacey](https://terrancehah.com/pacey): Race readiness, Garmin metrics, GPX course analysis, training plans and post-race reviews.
- [Pacey questions](https://terrancehah.com/pacey#questions): Garmin requirements, readiness, training sync and course uploads.

## Pacey facts

Pacey compares recent running fitness with a goal time chosen by the runner, highlighting strengths and areas to develop. It displays Garmin training and recovery data and analyses uploaded GPX routes. Training blocks cover up to 26 weeks; the runner chooses when to sync the current calendar week to Garmin, with later weeks available to review. Pacey uses the open-source python-garminconnect project (https://github.com/cyberjunky/python-garminconnect) to access Garmin data. The public demo can be explored with sample data.

## Canonical content

The public product page is https://terrancehah.com/pacey. App and demo URLs are interactive entry points, not separate product descriptions. API endpoints are not public reference content. Automated access does not bypass authentication.
